ItemId.description: The tool's 26-character id; omit it to create a new one.

Name.description: The name authors pick the tool by.

ClientId.description: The client id of the tool's OpenID application, imported with the OpenID application step.

DeploymentId.description: The deployment id sent with every launch.

LoginInitiationUrl.description: The tool's OIDC login initiation URL.

DeepLinkingUrl.description: The tool's Deep Linking URL, or null.

JwksUrl.description: The URL of the tool's JSON Web Key Set, or null when the key set is on its OpenID application.

CustomParameters.description: Custom parameters, one name=value per line.

AllowNamesAndRoles.description: Whether the tool may read course rosters.

AllowGrades.description: Whether the tool may manage line items and post scores.

Enabled.description: Whether the tool can be launched.

SubjectSalt.description: The salt of the ids the tool knows people by, in base64. Keep it to keep the ids; a new one is made when it is empty.

Tools.description: The external tools' settings to create or update.
